newsitem.title: HUNGARY: World Bank to lend $7.75 million to Hungary.
newsitem.headline: World Bank to lend $7.75 million to Hungary.

text.p: The World Bank will extend a $7.75 million loan to Hungary to finance the modernisation of public administration, government spokesman Elemer Kiss told a news conference on Thursday.
"The government has authorised the Finance Minister to sign the loan agreement, which will finance the modernisation of state administration," Kiss said.
The credit will have a maturity of 12 years, with a three-year grace period and fixed interest, the rate of which Kiss did not disclose.
This is a loan with favourable conditions," he added.
